rows.note: Use this for deliberately making an innocent person appear guilty or falsely blaming them.

example.english: They conspired to frame an innocent person, claiming he stole something.
example.traditional: 佢哋夾埋屈人，話個無辜嘅人偷咗嘢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 gaap3 maai4 wat1 jan4 waa6 go3 mou4 gu1 ge3 jan4 tau1 zo2 je5

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for a rigid frame holding a picture or painting.

example.english: This frame is perfect for displaying your painting.
example.traditional: 呢個相架好啱擺你幅畫。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 soeng2 gaa2 hou2 ngaam1 baai2 nei5 fuk1 waa2

rows.note: Use this when framing an idea means packaging or presenting it in a particular way for people to interpret.

example.english: This story uses romance to frame a political issue, making it easier to digest.
example.traditional: 呢個故事用愛情包裝政治議題，令人容易入口。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gu3 si6 jung6 oi3 cing4 baau1 zong1 zing3 zi6 ji5 tai4 ling6 jan4 jung4 ji6 jap6 hau2

rows.note: Use this for a person's physical build or overall body shape.

example.english: They have a tall, solid frame, so everything looks good on them.
example.traditional: 佢身形高大，著咩衫都好睇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 san1 jing4 gou1 daai6 zoek3 me1 saam1 dou1 hou2 tai2

rows.note: Use this for choosing and positioning what appears within the camera's view.

example.english: The director told us to move a little closer to frame the shot, so we would not get passers-by in it.
example.traditional: 導演叫我哋行近少少取景，唔好影到啲路人。
example.jyutping: dou6 jin2 giu3 ngo5 dei6 haang4 gan6 siu2 siu2 ceoi2 ging2 m4 hou2 jing2 dou2 di1 lou6 jan4

rows.note: Use this for the supporting skeleton of a building or other constructed object before its outer parts are added.

example.english: The building's frame is up, but the walls haven't been enclosed yet.
example.traditional: 棟樓而家起好咗骨架，仲未封牆。
example.jyutping: dung6 lau4 ji4 gaa1 hei2 hou2 zo2 gwat1 gaa2 zung6 mei6 fung1 coeng4

rows.note: Use this when putting a picture or photograph into a decorative frame.

example.english: I’ll frame your painting and bring it back to you tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我幫你幅畫裝框，聽日拎返畀你。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bong1 nei5 fuk1 waa2 zong1 kwaang1 ting1 jat6 ling1 faan1 bei2 nei5

rows.note: Use this for an abstract framework or context used to understand and interpret something.

example.english: This frame of reference can help us understand the issue.
example.traditional: 呢個框架可以幫我哋理解件事。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 kwaang1 gaa2 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 dei6 lei5 gaai2 gin6 si6
